overview_description.description: AlgoUniversity is building live teaching infrastructure that enables a handful of top educators (from Google, Facebook, etc) to coach a large number of students. AlgoUniversity trains college students in year-long live cohorts and in return, they pay the company a portion of their salary as fees once they get a tech job via an Income Sharing Agreement.

about_short_description.short_description: AlgoUniversity is a job-driven virtual education hub that trains Indian university students to become software engineers.

product.name: Leap Batch for Working Professionals
product.description: A weekend-oriented live training program focused on data structures and algorithms for engineers with 0-4 years of experience.

product.name: Data Structures & Algorithms Curriculum
product.description: A structured curriculum focused on mastering data structures and algorithms to prepare for technical interviews.

product.name: Industry-Oriented Projects and Externship
product.description: A program component where students build projects using current technology stacks under mentorship, earning an externship certificate.

product.name: Dedicated Placement Cell
product.description: A team that assists students with resume optimization, mock interviews, and job application processes for product-based companies.

product.name: Personalized Mentorship Program
product.description: One-on-one mentorship sessions with experienced engineers from top tech companies to guide career development and interview preparation.

product.name: MasterClasses and Workshops
product.description: Live sessions and workshops on specialized topics like low-level design, coding techniques, and resume crafting.
